As a bonus action, you enter a stance of focused readiness, immediately lashing out at creatures of your choice within 10 feet: each must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your attack bonus with the weapon used) or take that weapon's normal damage. The stance lasts 1 minute, granting the following while active:

  • Death Weave. Reducing a creature to 0 hit points grants you temporary hit points equal to your focus ability modifier plus half your monk level.
  • Gundark Slap. Once per turn, hitting a creature with an unarmed strike or monk weapon lets you prevent it from taking reactions until the end of your next turn.
  • Sleeping Krayt. You may use your focus ability modifier in place of Strength for Strength checks and saving throws, and you have advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

Being incapacitated or dying ends these effects early. You can use this feature once between long rests; once spent, you may instead pay 1 focus point to use it again, though your maximum focus points then drop by 1 until your next long rest.
